capture: Reference outputs were evaluated with the original source before release refactoring, using Python 3.12.14, numpy 2.3.5 and scipy 1.17.0. Elapsed timings are excluded.
audited_core.json: Seed 73021: real and proper-complex conjugate filters, pre-correction causal scores, completed-block variance fits, GREAT updates, repeated/close/high-concentration moment outputs. fixture_values in test_source_regression.py records the calls.
audited_contact.npz: Original paper configuration, moving sphere trials 0 and 7. Saved observations at indices 0,1,3,63,127,143,191; corrected states and decisions at measurements 4,16,64,128,192. Also fixed-plane anisotropy fixture.
audited_contact_metrics.json: Original test_episode with dense checkpoints every four measurements, paper selected beta 0.9, trial 7; four retained controls. Checkpoint rows exclude episode-average rows.
audited_beamforming.json: Exact original short-run configuration and frozen policy used by the decision fixture.
audited_beamforming.npz: Original n=32 abrupt stream, trial 0, shortened T=32; corrected states and all retained decisions at measurements 8 and 16.
audited_noise.json: Original fixed-direction noise-change trial 0, shortened T=64 with change at 33 for this fixture. Pre-correction score, actions and current/next scales for the supplied, fixed and EM controls. This short fixture does not stand for the full T=256 paper experiment.
